h1: 80 KB photo size: compress photo to 80 KB
intro: Get the 80 KB photo size for large photos and scans. Add a picture and download a JPG of 72–80 KB, processed on your own phone without any upload.

steps.name: Add your image
steps.text: Take a photo or pick one from your gallery. JPG, PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC files all work.

steps.name: Check the target
steps.text: 80 KB is already selected. Type a minimum if your form sets one, and decide whether the pixel size may change.

steps.name: Let it work
steps.text: The tool tries the highest JPEG quality that stays under 80 KB and makes the picture smaller only when it has to.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: When every line of the pass check has a tick, save the JPG and upload it to your form.

faq.q: Why does the IAF signature need 80 KB or more?
faq.a: That is the IAF rule: 80–150 KB. Use the 100 KB page, which lands at 90–100 KB, inside the range.

faq.q: Is 80 KB fine for a 50–100 KB handwritten declaration?
faq.a: Yes. A file of 72–80 KB is inside the range with about 20 KB to spare.

faq.q: Will my image be resized to reach 80 KB?
faq.a: Only made smaller if it is too big. A normal phone photo is reduced to a sensible size; a small image keeps its pixels and gets higher quality instead.
No. Compression runs inside your browser on your own device. The page even works offline after your first visit.

paras: An 80 KB file suits any 50–100 KB rule while keeping a clear margin under the cap: the IBPS, SBI, RBI and NABARD handwritten declaration, the REET Aadhaar card and marksheet images, and the IAF Agniveervayu thumb. One trap: the IAF Agniveervayu signature must be at least 80 KB (80–150 KB). A file of 72–80 KB can fall short, so use the 100 KB or 150 KB page for it.
At 80 KB a portrait shows fine hair and fabric texture, and a photographed document keeps crisp printed text. On a phone screen most people cannot tell an 80 KB face photo from the original.

As a rough guide, a passport-style photo on a plain background stays clean at about 350×470 pixels in 80 KB. A busy background or a dim, noisy shot needs more kilobytes for the same size, and a signature on white paper needs far fewer.

Whatever you add, the download is a baseline JPG (not progressive) between 72 and 80 KB. It stays under 80,000 bytes, so it passes whether the portal counts 1 KB as 1000 or 1024 bytes, and hidden camera and location data are removed.
If your document photo has a shadow from your hand or phone, retake it near a window. Compression keeps shadows faithfully, and a dark corner can hide text.
Pick the size just under the limit printed on your form. If the form gives both a minimum and a maximum, a range page fills in the minimum for you.
